important_evidence: SAMP is an ensemble random projection model with novel PSAAC features, outperforms iAMPpred and AMPScanner V2 on balanced and imbalanced datasets.
AmpGram outperforms AMPScanner, CAMPR3R and iAMPpred, validated on lactoferrin and thrombin AMPs.
Both models are candidates for AMP benchmark due to public code availability (SAMP) and R package/web-server (AmpGram).
uncertainties: Possible DOI/PMID mismatches: SAMP paper PMID 39573886 linked to doi 10.1101/gr.254557.119 (Genome Research?) but journal is Briefings in functional genomics; same for PMID 38712184 with doi 10.1128/aac.02340-16.
AmpGram paper PMID 32560350 has doi 10.1074/jbc.M111.303602 which does not match the title (likely incorrect).
Many repository and dataset entries extracted by regex (SHARP, SAMP., etc.) may be false positives; confidence 0.6-0.7.
Full-text for AmpGram paper was unrelated to the article; confirmation needed.
